notablePrerequisites:
Illusionist's Bracers attached to Fyndhorn Brownie.
Fyndhorn Brownie and Karametra's Acolyte do not have summoning sickness.
Your devotion to green is at least four.
description:
Activate Karametra's Acolyte by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Fyndhorn Brownie's ability by paying {2}{G} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Trigger Illusionist Bracer's, copying Fyndhorn Brownie's ability targeting Karametra's Acolyte 
Resolve both Fyndhorn Brownie abilities, untapping it and Karametra's Acolyte
Repeat
